Leadership Management And Leadership Product Management Productivity Our Very Own Baseball Furies The Ringmaster 1 hour ago -- Listen Share Some days it was cards. Some days it was ball hockey. And some days it was baseball with a tennis ball by the docks. Then one ball hit a steel door, and a senior manager erupted. 30 years in the warehouse taught me that we weren’t playing for their approval. We were playing for us.
